install.name: Python 3.15.2
install.check: mise exec -- python -c 'import sys; raise SystemExit(sys.version_info[:2] != (3, 15))'

install.name: Python dependencies
install.check: test -x .venv/bin/python && .venv/bin/python -c 'import fastapi, httpx, httpx2, pytest, uvicorn' && test -x .venv/bin/ruff
install.run: mise exec -- python -m venv .venv && .venv/bin/python -m pip install --disable-pip-version-check -r requirements-dev.txt
